## Vesta 1.1.4

- Improved Legit Sync: directly visible players remain fully opaque, while radar- and sound-revealed players use a smooth configurable opacity pulse and fade.
- Added legacy text-only display modes for projectile and bomb world indicators alongside the existing circular indicators.
- Redesigned Vesta Radar with a cleaner responsive layout, improved mobile presentation, aligned equipment cards, and clearer player direction markers.
